summary: Tested NEW PO selection/commitment workflow on Production Plan page (checkbox on Open PO Demand tab, Remove action on MRP tab, shared selection state, actor-name capture, full history, optimistic-UI checkbox fix). All backend endpoints (po-selections, toggle, history) pass via pytest (7/7). MRP generation confirmed fast (~15-20s in this env, well under the 1-8min budget) both via direct curl polling and in-browser click. Verified via Playwright: rapid 4x checkbox clicks toggled instantly True/False/True/False every time (no stickiness) matching optimistic-update fix, no-name guard blocks + toasts without persisting, selected-only filter count matched stat card, History dialog opened and showed 'Selected by <name>' with timestamp, MRP tab hint/stat correctly showed selected count and 'X / Y' format, and the MRP-tab 'Remove' action correctly deselected the exact PO line (confirmed via API: key 9006139::100139235 flipped to selected=false, unrelated selections untouched). Light regression: nav to BOM Explorer/Purchasing Plan/Inventory/Admin loads clean with zero console errors; MRP search filter still works.
critical_code_review_comments: po_selection_service.py: clean, well-documented, correct upsert + append-only history pattern. selection_key() correctly normalizes internal_pono float->int on both backend and frontend (selectionKey() in ProductionPlanPage.js) to keep keys stable - verified consistent in practice.

mrp_service.build_mrp_plan: selection filter applied correctly before BOM explosion (rows filtered by selection_key(...) in selected_keys) - verified live: 5-6 selected out of 787 total open PO lines produced total_po_lines<=selected_count as expected, PO Lines Considered stat rendered 'X / Y' correctly.

ProductionPlanPage.js toggleSelection(): optimistic update correctly happens BEFORE the axios call and rolls back only in the catch block on error; guard for empty actorName returns early WITHOUT any optimistic mutation (verified: unchanged state, no persisted change, toast shown) - correct fix for the reported 'sticky checkbox' issue, confirmed via 4x rapid clicks toggling instantly and correctly every time.

File size note (non-blocking): ProductionPlanPage.js is 1324 lines - exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting OpenPoDemandTab/MrpPlanTab/SelectionHistoryDialog into separate component files for maintainability, no functional issue found.
